title: Start your practice project
task: Your practice project is a small pretend helper that handles shop refunds. You will add to it every Saturday until March. Today: make a new folder with git, add a CLAUDE.md file, and make three simple pretend tools (find a customer, look up an order, give a refund) that read from one JSON file.
build: Repo, root CLAUDE.md, three MCP tools (get_customer, lookup_order, process_refund) over a JSON file
